title: dispatch and begin placed on the server start the worker's headless session in the central clone, with a model credential and the cost cap
goal: A dispatch or begin job placed on server runs in a worktree of the server's clone of the item's integration remote, with the model credential of its identity read by kj_cred (never argv), the budget and group cap of the paid-job rule, and stage-back pushing the worker branch; serve --dry-run prints the argv and the environment names each job would run with, values left out; no model credential ends the job refused naming the identity

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess,threading,http.server
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    seen=[]; out={}
    def do_POST(s):
        n=int(s.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0); H.seen.append((s.path,json.loads(s.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")))
        b=json.dumps(H.out).encode(); s.send_response(200); s.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
srv=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),H); threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
OPA=f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}"
dec=lambda **k: {"result":dict({"executor":"workstation","identity":"none","fallback":None,"fallback_after_s":0,"budget_cap_usd":None,"decided_by":"default"},**k)}
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"))
kj=lambda *x,e=None: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py",*x],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300,env=e or env)
o=os.path.join(d,"o.git"); subprocess.run(["git","clone","-q","--bare","--local",".",o],check=True)
cd=os.path.join(d,"cred"); f=os.path.join(cd,"group","corp","ops"); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(f))
H.out=dec(executor="server",identity="group-bot",budget_cap_usd=10,decided_by="group:corp/ops")
j=json.loads(kj("submit","dispatch","ST-aaaaaaaa","--budget","1","--no-ensure","--opa",OPA,"--clone-url","file://"+o).stdout)["job"]
r1=kj("serve","--kind","server","--data",os.path.join(d,"srv"),"--cred-dir",cd,"--once","--dry-run")
open(f,"w").write("model-key-placeholder"); os.chmod(f,0o600)
r2=kj("serve","--kind","server","--data",os.path.join(d,"srv"),"--cred-dir",cd,"--once","--dry-run")
assert "group-bot" in r1.stdout+r1.stderr and "refused" in r1.stdout+r1.stderr, r1
assert "claude" in r2.stdout and os.path.join(d,"srv") in r2.stdout and "model-key-placeholder" not in r2.stdout+r2.stderr, r2
